abilities.name: leitvia/activate-token-set
abilities.label: Activate token set
abilities.description: Writes the presets of a token set into the global styles of the active theme. The set ID comes from leitvia/create-token-set or the sets of leitvia/get-tokens. The base hash is the hash of the global styles. No ability returns this hash: send base_hash empty and repeat the call once with current_hash from leitvia_stale_hash.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/add-media
abilities.label: Add media
abilities.description: Adds an image to the media library from a URL of this site or as Base64 data up to 5 MB, with alt text or marked as decorative. URLs of other hosts are rejected; nothing is fetched from them. base_hash is empty. Images already in the library are used by their ID in compose-page and update-block.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/apply-package
abilities.label: Apply change package
abilities.description: Applies the open operations of a change package, all or the listed ones. Find the package with leitvia/list-packages and check its diff with leitvia/get-package first. Each operation checks its base hash; one whose target changed stays open with a conflict, the others are written with snapshot and audit entry. Agents may only apply operations whose autonomy level is autonomous.

operations.description: Operation IDs to apply; empty or missing for every open operation.

abilities.name: leitvia/apply-recipe
abilities.label: Apply recipe
abilities.description: Sets up the site from a recipe of leitvia/list-recipes: content model, token set, style variation, header and footer, pages from patterns, navigation, reading settings and options that save data. Each part runs through its own ability with the autonomy level of its area; what may not go live lands in one change package, and with a package key everything does. Settings that point to a page waiting in that package (front page, privacy policy page) are set when the package is applied. Pages that exist and header or footer changed since are kept, so the recipe can run again after the package was applied. Review the package with leitvia/get-package.

recipe.description: Name from leitvia/list-recipes, for example leitvia/blog.

package.description: Key of the task: every part goes into the change package of that key, nothing goes live.

abilities.name: leitvia/audit-site
abilities.label: Audit site
abilities.description: Runs the content checks (headings, alt text, link text, block validity, tokens, contrast, one h1 and landmarks) over published content, at most 20 posts per call in ID order. Also reports classic content without blocks, deprecated patterns, preset slugs missing from the active tokens, internal links that lead to no page or to the old address of a renamed post, and pages that look like legal texts without a page kind. Pass next as after for the following page; next is null at the end.

after.description: Start after this post ID, the next value of the previous call.

abilities.name: leitvia/check-composition
abilities.label: Check composition
abilities.description: Scores a page against the composition rules of the contract: pass pattern slugs in page order (block:<ID> for a Lab pattern; only approved ones count as known), or a post ID to read the sections of a saved page from metadata.patternName. Returns the findings (rule and 0-based section index), the score from 100 down, the minimum score for autonomous writes and per finding up to three patterns that would fix it.

template.description: Template slug, for example page-landing; for a post its saved template is used.

abilities.name: leitvia/compose-page
abilities.label: Compose page
abilities.description: Creates a page from patterns in the order of a page frame of the contract. Plan it with leitvia/plan-page first; base_hash is empty for the new page. Per section only texts (also quote citations and details summaries), links and images at block IDs of the pattern outline can change; a text that would drop a link is refused. Each section keeps metadata.patternName (core/block/<ID> for a Lab pattern). Unknown patterns are rejected with a pointer to leitvia/list-patterns, deprecated ones with their replacement, Lab patterns that are not approved (also through a part) with leitvia_pattern_not_approved. Later changes go through leitvia/update-content and leitvia/update-block.

frame.description: Type of a page frame from pageFrames in the contract, for example home or service.

pattern.description: Pattern slug such as leitvia/hero-split-image, or block:<ID> for a Lab pattern.

block.description: Block ID or path ID from the outline.

text.description: Plain text of a paragraph, heading, list item or button, the citation of a quote or the summary of a details block.

link_text.description: Part of text that stays linked when the text holds a link, such as the mail address in a contact line. Without it the link stays around its old text, and a text without that is refused unless the link only points to #.

url.description: Link of a button, or of the one link in a paragraph, heading or list item (mailto: and tel: work too).

template.description: Page template of the contract instead of the one of the frame, for example page-docs.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/create-pattern
abilities.label: Create pattern
abilities.description: Creates a pattern in the Lab as a draft with version 0.1.0 from block markup; base_hash is empty. Blocks and their attributes come from leitvia/list-blocks. The checks run on its markup, design tokens included. To build on an existing pattern use leitvia/vary-pattern.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/create-token-set
abilities.label: Create token set
abilities.description: Creates a token set from a DTCG document. Start from the document leitvia/get-tokens returns; base_hash is empty for the new set. It must compile against the contract and pass every token set check; contrast findings name the failing pair and the ratio it needs. Activate it with leitvia/activate-token-set.

document.description: DTCG token document, as leitvia/get-tokens returns it.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/define-content-type
abilities.label: Define content type
abilities.description: Adds or replaces entries of the content model (postTypes, taxonomies, relations, settings) and keeps the others. Read the declaration with leitvia/get-content-model first. The base hash is the hash of the content model. No ability returns this hash: send base_hash empty and repeat the call once with current_hash from leitvia_stale_hash. showInAbilities stays a decision of a person: agents may not set it.

declaration.description: Content model declaration with the entries to add or replace, see leitvia/get-content-model.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-block
abilities.label: Get block
abilities.description: Returns one block of a post by its ID or path ID with all attributes, its own markup, the attachments of the images in that markup, its hash, the IDs of its children and the document hash. Classic content without blocks is one block p:0 named core/freeform.

block.description: Block ID from the page outline.

attachments.description: Images in inner_html that are attachments of this site, in order: attachment ID and the src as written.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-content-model
abilities.label: Get content model
abilities.description: Returns the content model declaration: post types, taxonomies, fields, relations and site settings with their definitions, never content. valid is false when the declaration fails the schema and nothing of it is registered.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-contract
abilities.label: Get contract
abilities.description: Returns the site this connection works on (address, REST base, name, language, whether it is part of a multisite network) and the design contract of the active theme: version, rules, color roles, contrast pairs, composition rules, page frames, template parts, templates, block styles and style variations. Compare site.url with the address of your task before the first write. Patterns come from list-patterns, blocks from list-blocks.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-package
abilities.label: Get change package
abilities.description: Returns a change package with its operations: status, conflicts and, for open operations, a block diff against the current state (per block added, removed, moved or changed with text before and after and the changed attributes).

abilities.name: leitvia/get-page-outline
abilities.label: Get page outline
abilities.description: Returns a post as a compact block tree: per block the ID, name, pattern, the first 80 characters of text, size, hash and children. Blocks without a stable ID have a path ID such as p:0.2.1 until the next save. Use the document hash as base_hash for changes and get-block for full attributes.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-pattern
abilities.label: Get pattern
abilities.description: Returns one pattern of the theme or of Leitvia Studio with its markup, metadata and the first 20 posts and templates that use it (more is true when there are further ones).

slug.description: Pattern slug from list-patterns, for example leitvia/hero-split-image, or block:<ID> for a Lab pattern.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-product
abilities.label: Get product
abilities.description: Returns one product or variation: texts, images with alt text, categories and tags with their hash, attributes, price (read only), tax and shipping class, stock status, merchandising and the hash to use as base_hash. No sales, order or customer figures.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-tokens
abilities.label: Get tokens
abilities.description: Returns the active design tokens as a DTCG document (of the active token set, else of the current global styles), the token sets with their status, the active style variations, whether the global styles drifted from the active set and the contrast findings of the current palette.

abilities.name: leitvia/list-blocks
abilities.label: List blocks
abilities.description: Returns the block catalog of Leitvia Studio and its add-ons with attribute schema and usage rules. With post_type only the blocks the editor allows for that post type.

post_type.description: Limit to the blocks allowed for this post type.

description.description: Translated description of what the block does.

parent.description: Blocks this block must be a direct child of, null for anywhere.

ancestor.description: Blocks this block must be inside at any depth, null for anywhere.

supports.description: Supports of block.json an agent may use: align, anchor, color, spacing, typography, dimensions, border, shadow, layout, html, multiple, reusable, inserter, interactivity. Their attributes (className, style, backgroundColor and so on) are not listed under attributes.

attributes.description: JSON schema of the block attributes from block.json. A property with source is stored in the block markup, not in the block comment; rich-text is a string of HTML.

innerBlocks.description: Blocks allowed directly inside: allowedBlocks of block.json, otherwise the catalog blocks that name this block as parent. null when block.json sets no limit.

usage.description: When to use the block. Required for Studio blocks, optional for add-on blocks.

owner.description: Slug of the add-on that registered the block in the Studio blocks registry, core for core blocks.

extension.description: Core blocks only: what Studio changes about the block.

abilities.name: leitvia/list-packages
abilities.label: List change packages
abilities.description: Lists your change packages, newest first: ID, title, key, state (open, applied, partial, rejected, rolled_back), operations per status and a preview link.

abilities.name: leitvia/list-patterns
abilities.label: List patterns
abilities.description: Lists the patterns of the theme, of Leitvia Studio and of its add-ons (source addon) with composition metadata, image slots, when to use and avoid them, lab status and the replacement of deprecated ones, followed by the Lab patterns (slug block:<ID>, source lab) with their lab status, version and document hash, and the composition of the theme pattern they vary. Only approved Lab patterns count as known in check-composition. Filter by role, tone, layout or category; at most 50 per page. Markup and usage come from get-pattern.

role.description: Filter by this value of the composition metadata.

tone.description: Filter by this value of the composition metadata.

layout.description: Filter by this value of the composition metadata.

abilities.name: leitvia/list-products
abilities.label: List products
abilities.description: Lists the products of the shop, 20 per page, with title, type, status, price (read only), stock status, featured flag and hash, plus all product categories with their hash. Filter by category or search text. Orders, coupons and customers are never listed.

abilities.name: leitvia/list-recipes
abilities.label: List recipes
abilities.description: Lists the site recipes of Leitvia Studio and its add-ons with owner, pages and whether the plugins they require are active.

abilities.name: leitvia/plan-page
abilities.label: Plan page
abilities.description: Proposes a page for a goal and content points: page frame, template, the patterns in page order with role, slot, text lengths and the points each section carries, and the composition score. Without AI the plan follows the page frames, examples and composition rules of the contract and is the same for the same input. With ai set to true the AI connector the site owner set up in WordPress refines it; the goal, the points and pattern names with their metadata are sent to that provider. Writes nothing; build the page with leitvia/compose-page.

frame.description: Type of a page frame; without it the frame named in the goal, else home.

ai.description: Refine the plan through the AI connector of the site. Sends the goal, the points and pattern names to that provider.

abilities.name: leitvia/repair-links
abilities.label: Repair links
abilities.description: Repairs internal links of one post: from pairs of old and new link, or with auto through the old slugs WordPress keeps for redirects. The base hash is the hash of the post from leitvia/get-page-outline. Only links of this site change. External links are never requested, only listed in the report, as are internal links that lead nowhere and cannot be resolved.

auto.description: Find links to posts whose slug changed and point them to the current address.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/replace-pattern
abilities.label: Replace deprecated pattern
abilities.description: Replaces the sections of one post that use a deprecated pattern (metadata.patternName) with the replacement the contract names, all of them or the one section given by block. leitvia/audit-site reports the posts that use deprecated patterns; the base hash is the hash of the post from leitvia/get-page-outline. Texts and button links move over in order per block type. A section without replacement is rejected with leitvia_no_replacement.

block.description: Block ID or path ID of a top-level section from the outline.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/rollback
abilities.label: Roll back change package
abilities.description: Rolls back the applied operations of a change package from their snapshots. Package IDs come from leitvia/list-packages. If anyone changed a target since, nothing is rolled back and leitvia_rollback_conflict lists both hashes and the diff. Agents may only roll back operations whose autonomy level is autonomous.

abilities.name: leitvia/set-alt-text
abilities.label: Set alt text
abilities.description: Sets the alt text of an image: without post and block on the attachment in the media library (base_hash of the attachment), with post and block on one image or cover block that shows the image (base_hash of the post). leitvia/get-page-outline returns both hashes, for the attachment with its ID as post. leitvia/audit-site reports missing alt text. Call it once per place, with the same package key. The alt text check applies.

block.description: Block ID or path ID of the image or cover block from the outline.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/set-merchandising
abilities.label: Set merchandising
abilities.description: Sets the featured flag, the upsells, the cross-sells and the sort order of one product. The lists replace the current ones. Read the product with leitvia/get-product first and send its hash as base_hash; product IDs come from leitvia/list-products.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/set-variation
abilities.label: Set style variation
abilities.description: Applies a style variation of the contract to the global styles of the active theme: a full variation replaces them, a colors or typography variation replaces only its part. Names come from the style variations of leitvia/get-contract. The base hash is the hash of the global styles. No ability returns this hash: send base_hash empty and repeat the call once with current_hash from leitvia_stale_hash.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/update-block
abilities.label: Update block
abilities.description: Changes one block found by its ID or path ID: attributes from the block catalog and the level of a heading, the text of a paragraph, heading, list item or button, the citation of a quote, the summary of a details block, the link of a button or of the one link in a text (link_text names the linked part), or the image of an image or cover block with alt text. Static markup is rebuilt with the HTML API; changes it cannot rebuild safely are rejected with leitvia_static_markup. Read the post with leitvia/get-page-outline first and send its hash as base_hash; get-block shows the current attributes. For several text changes in one post use leitvia/update-content.

block.description: Block ID or path ID from the outline.

text.description: Plain text of a paragraph, heading, list item or button, the citation of a quote or the summary of a details block.

link_text.description: Part of text that stays linked when the text holds a link, such as the mail address in a contact line. Without it the link stays around its old text, and a text without that is refused unless the link only points to #.

url.description: Link of a button, or of the one link in a paragraph, heading or list item (mailto: and tel: work too).

attributes.description: Attributes from leitvia/list-blocks; for a core/heading its level, 1 to 6.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/update-content
abilities.label: Update content
abilities.description: Updates title, excerpt, slug and the texts and button links of several blocks of one post in one operation, blocks found by their ID from the outline. Instead of blocks, content replaces the whole content with block markup, for example to turn classic content into blocks; the new content may hold no classic block. Read the post with leitvia/get-page-outline first and send its hash as base_hash. A slug change is a URL change and lands at most as a suggestion; after one, leitvia/repair-links with auto points the links of other posts to the new address. For attributes or images of a block use leitvia/update-block.

block.description: Block ID or path ID from the outline.

text.description: Plain text of a paragraph, heading, list item or button.

content.description: Block markup that replaces the whole content; not together with blocks.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/update-navigation
abilities.label: Update navigation
abilities.description: Replaces the links of a navigation menu, by default the one published last, which headers without a chosen menu show. Send items (with one level of sub items) or block markup of navigation links, submenus, page lists and mega menus. Links point to this site, use https, mailto: or tel:, and need a text that names their target. The base hash is the hash of the menu, empty when the site has none. No ability returns this hash: send base_hash empty and repeat the call once with current_hash from leitvia_stale_hash.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/update-product
abilities.label: Update product
abilities.description: Updates texts, status, images, categories and tags of one product or variation, and its prices, tax and shipping class. Read the product with leitvia/get-product first and send its hash as base_hash. Images need alt text (set it with leitvia/set-alt-text first). Changes to prices, taxes or shipping land at most as a suggestion unless a person unlocked them.

image.description: Attachment ID of an image with alt text, 0 to remove.

regular_price.description: Price as a decimal number with a dot, empty for none. A price change lands at most as a suggestion.

sale_price.description: Price as a decimal number with a dot, empty for none. A price change lands at most as a suggestion.

shipping_class.description: Term ID of the shipping class, 0 for none.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/update-product-category
abilities.label: Update product category
abilities.description: Updates name, description, parent and image of a product category, or name and description of a product tag. Use the hash of the term from list-products or get-product as base_hash. The image needs alt text.

image.description: Attachment ID of an image with alt text, 0 to remove.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/update-template-part
abilities.label: Update template part
abilities.description: Replaces a template part of the contract, such as header, footer or sidebar, with a pattern made for its area or with changed block markup. Part names come from leitvia/get-contract, patterns from leitvia/list-patterns. The base hash is the hash of the template part. No ability returns this hash: send base_hash empty and repeat the call once with current_hash from leitvia_stale_hash.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/vary-pattern
abilities.label: Vary pattern
abilities.description: Creates a variant of a Lab pattern (block:<ID>) or a theme pattern (slug) as a draft in the Lab, from new markup or from the original with edits at block IDs; base_hash is empty. Originals come from leitvia/list-patterns, block IDs for edits from leitvia/get-pattern.

block.description: Block ID or path ID from the outline.

text.description: Plain text of a paragraph, heading, list item or button, the citation of a quote or the summary of a details block.

link_text.description: Part of text that stays linked when the text holds a link, such as the mail address in a contact line. Without it the link stays around its old text, and a text without that is refused unless the link only points to #.

url.description: Link of a button, or of the one link in a paragraph, heading or list item (mailto: and tel: work too).
